what: Time from opening a conversation to its first painted feed row, on a production build, before and after the persisted tail cache.
runtime: the Bun pinned in the Dockerfile, serving `next start` (never `next dev`)
browser: headless Chrome over raw CDP; desktop 1280x800 and phone 390x844

corpus.note: Invented transcripts in a throwaway home under the temp root; no account, no operator state.

statistic: median of 3, with the min-max spread in the attribution string

knownArtifact: Some reopen samples show the document itself taking ~57 s. Chrome holds six HTTP/1.1 sockets per origin and the Viewer log stream never ends, so a driven sequence of documents can find every socket held; the median is unaffected and the spread shows it.
